_why: A device integration that RECEIVES over the tailnet. tools/ is off the URL surface by default and that is a privacy property; this file is the deliberate opt-in, and it exists because the iPhone posts chunks to this server over the tailnet. Without it the phone's uploads fail silently.
_aliases_why: Historical names. The iOS app ships with /biomimetic-radar as its default endpoint and phones already in the field hold that URL; /fieldlab-recorder is this repo's name until 2026-09-15, which the watch page, RUN.md and fieldlab-client.js embeds used; the other two are folders this code lived in during 2026-08-24's restructure. Removing an alias strands a device or a bookmark.
